justification: Minor: data lists only, no code. Withholds 311 council rules whose own text limits them to a named place with no outline, each verified by a reader against the council's page with a verbatim quote that I re-checked mechanically, and lists them on the council not-covered list per the 2026-10-15 ruling. Applied live with owner approval and a row-level backup; same pattern as #1655 and #1662.

break_it.scenario: A re-publish re-keys the withheld rows and serves them to every house again.
break_it.what_happens: Every house in the council sees rules for one named place again.
break_it.how: The rows are in never_serve.json with text fingerprints, which derive_precinct_keys, gate_rules and enrichment skip, and DQ-148 fails if one is served.

break_it.scenario: A rule that is general or only excludes a place is hidden as place-limited.
break_it.what_happens: Every house in the council loses a rule that applies to it.
break_it.how: Only rows where a reader gave a place name and a verbatim quote that I re-found in the supplied text were used; general, unsure and unverified rows were left alone.
break_it.repro: 311 of 355 place-limited calls passed the quote check; 44 did not and were excluded.

break_it.scenario: A house inside the named place loses a rule that applies to it.
break_it.what_happens: That house no longer sees the rule on its main list.
break_it.how: Accepted under the 2026-10-15 ruling that unmapped small-area rules are hidden and listed as not covered yet; the council-level notice lists them.
break_it.repro: Rows are listed per council and chapter in not_covered_2026-10-15.json.

post_merge.manual_verify: The council not-covered notice is not yet checked in a browser.
